result.topic_en: Integral representations of $\log\Pi(s)$ (the factorial/Gamma function) and of its logarithmic derivative, leading to a Stirling-type formula with a remainder integral, followed by attempts to transform that remainder integral by a substitution.
result.transcription:
$\int_0^\infty e^{-sx}\,dx = \frac{1}{s}$
$\Pi s = \frac{\Pi(s+1)}{s+1}$
$\log \Pi(s+n) = \log \Pi(s+n) - \log(s+1) \quad - \log(s+n)$
$\int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-x}-e^{-sx}}{x}\,dx = \log s$
$\log \Pi(s+n) - \log \Pi(s+n) - \int_0^\infty \left(\frac{e^{-x}}{x} - \frac{e^{-sx}}{x}\left(\frac{1-e^{-nx}}{e^x-1}\right)\right)dx$
$\psi s = -\frac{1}{s+1} \qquad - \frac{1}{s+n} + \log(s+n)$
$\psi s = -\int \frac{e^{-sx}(1-e^{-nx})}{e^x-1}\,\partial x + \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-x}-e^{-(n+s)x}}{x}\,\partial x$
$= \int \frac{e^{-x}}{x} - \frac{e^{-sx}}{e^x-1}\,\partial x + [-\int_0^\infty e^{-(n+s)x}\left(\frac{1}{e^x-1} - \frac{1}{x}\right)\partial x-]$
$\frac{1}{e^x-1} + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{2}\frac{e^x+1}{e^x-1}$
$\log \Pi s = \int_0^\infty s\frac{e^{-x}}{x} - \frac{1-e^{-sx}}{x(e^x-1)}\,\partial x$
$s\log s - s = \int_0^\infty s\frac{e^{-x}}{x} - \frac{1-e^{-sx}}{x^2}\,\partial x$
$\log \Pi s = s\log s - s + \int_0^\infty \left(\frac{e^{-sx}-1}{x}\left(\frac{1}{e^x-1} - \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{2}\right) - \frac{1}{2}\frac{e^{-x}-1}{x}\right)\partial x + \frac{1}{2}\log s$
$= (s+\tfrac{1}{2})\log s - s - \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial x}{x}\left(\frac{1}{e^x-1} - \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{2}e^{-x}\right) + \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-sx}}{x}\left(\frac{1}{e^x-1} - \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{2}\right)\partial x$
$\int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-sx}\,\partial x}{x}\,x^n \int f y\,\frac{\partial y}{y}[?]\,\frac{1}{y-x} \qquad (0, x) \qquad n = 2\pi s$
$[-\ldots-]$
$1 - \frac{y}{x} = t \qquad (1, 0)$
$\int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-x}\,\partial x}{x}\int f\left(\frac{y}{s}\right) e^{-n\log\frac{y}{x}}\,\frac{\partial\frac{y}{x}}{\frac{y}{x}-1}$
$\int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-x}\,\partial x}{x}\int f\left(\frac{x}{s}(1-t)\right) e^{-n\log(1-t)}\,\frac{\partial t}{t}$
$\int \frac{e^{nt}}{\frac{x}{s} - \frac{x}{s}t}[?] \qquad \int e^{-n\log(1-t)}\,\frac{\partial t}{t}\int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-sx}\,\partial x}{x\,(e^{[-x-xt-]}-1)}[?]$
$\frac{e^{t+\frac{t^2}{2n}}}{e^{x-x\frac{t}{n}}-1}\,\frac{\partial t}{t} \qquad \frac{e^t}{e^x-1}\,\frac{\partial t}{t}$

methods.what: Functional equation of the Pi (factorial) function
Integral representation of the logarithmic derivative psi of Pi
Integral representation of s log s - s
Stirling formula with Binet-type remainder integral
Substitution t = 1 - y/x to transform a double integral of the remainder
